theorems.statement: ∀ (P N : ℕ) (ψ : Euclid N → Euclid P) (C : Set (Euclid N)), ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → IsCompact C → InjOn ψ C → (∀ y ∈ C, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ y)) → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ a ∈ C, ∀ b ∈ C, c * ‖a - b‖ ≤ ‖ψ a - ψ b‖
